topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview of cancer transformation
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the practical context, overarching goals, and learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Discovery of oncogenes and assays for cellular transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the historical progression from viral transmission of cancer to identifying cellular proto-oncogenes and establishing laboratory assays to measure transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes in cell cycle control
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the functional definitions, genetic mechanisms, and checkpoint regulation distinguishing oncogenes from tumor suppressors.

topics.label: Pathways, causes, and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in DNA repair, replication fidelity, and chromosome segregation produce genomic instability and cellular stress in cancer.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression, hereditary predisposition, and cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential somatic mutations and inherited genetic defects drive tumor development and therapeutic adaptation over time.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session, provides reading recommendations, and outlines the schedule for the next lecture.
